pull.title: test: replace hard-coded RPC error codes
pull.body:
**Problem:** When a test expects an RPC error by number, readers have to look up the code to tell which failure it covers.

**Fix:** Use the `RPCErrorCode` names in the C++ RPC tests and mirror the enum in the Python test framework.
Give the test client’s errors their own constants so `AuthServiceProxy` and `TestNodeCLI` can share the HTTP error code.

I split this out while reviewing #36976.

<details>

scripted-diff: test: export RPC error codes to Python

Expose `RPCErrorCode` to the Python functional tests using the names, values, and aliases from `src/rpc/protocol.h`.
Add a note beside the C++ enum to keep the Python definitions in sync.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-
rpc_codes_file=test/functional/test_framework/rpc_error_codes.py
sed -n '2,4p' test/functional/feature_io_errors.py > "$rpc_codes_file"
printf '\n# Values from RPCErrorCode in src/rpc/protocol.h.\n' >> "$rpc_codes_file"
sed -nE '/^enum RPCErrorCode$/,/^};$/s/^    (RPC_[A-Z0-9_]+) *= ([^,]+),.*/\1 = \2/p' src/rpc/protocol.h >> "$rpc_codes_file"
sed -i "/^enum RPCErrorCode$/i //! Keep $rpc_codes_file in sync with this enum." src/rpc/protocol.h
git add -N "$rpc_codes_file"
-END VERIFY SCRIPT-

scripted-diff: test: name RPC errors in assertions

Replace numeric first arguments to `assert_raises_rpc_error` with their primary `RPCErrorCode` names and import the constants each test uses.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path

definitions = Path("test/functional/test_framework/rpc_error_codes.py").read_text()
codes = {value: name for name, value in re.findall(r"^(RPC_\w+) = (-\d+)$", definitions, re.M)}
calls = re.compile(r"(^[ \t]*assert_raises_rpc_error\(\s*)(-\d+)\b", re.M)
for path in Path("test/functional").glob("*.py"):
    source = path.read_text()
    used = sorted({codes[value] for _, value in calls.findall(source)})
    if not used:
        continue
    imports = used[0] if len(used) == 1 else "(\n    " + ",\n    ".join(used) + ",\n)"
    source = calls.sub(lambda match: match[1] + codes[match[2]], source)
    source = re.sub(
        r"^from test_framework\.(?:script\w*|test_framework|util) import",
        lambda match: f"from test_framework.rpc_error_codes import {imports}\n{match[0]}",
        source, count=1, flags=re.M,
    )
    path.write_text(source)
PY
-END VERIFY SCRIPT-
